name: Meldmind
description: Start a chat, a council, or a mission in Meldmind and get the result back.

poll.when: Use this when the first reply says the run is still going.

notes: The token is shown once in Meldmind. It is not this file.
Nothing is sent, posted, or charged until you click Allow in Meldmind.
On this computer the address is the local Meldmind address. Zapier and Make in the cloud can call it only if you have made this computer reachable. Meldmind does not open a tunnel.
